message: I bought the photo editing licence (ORD-1066) but I don't need it anymore.

evidence.sql: SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.orders WHERE order_id = 'ORD-1066' AND customer_id = 'C010'
SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.refund_policy WHERE category = 'Digital' OR category = 'ALL'

rows.rule_text: Unused items may be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery.
Items that arrive damaged or defective are refunded in full within 30 days of delivery; a photo is requested.
If an order has not been delivered 14 days after the order date, the customer may choose a refund or a replacement.
Items marked final sale cannot be refunded unless they are defective.
Digital products (licences, downloads) are non-refundable once delivered, unless the product does not work.
Any refund above 200.00 must be reviewed by a support lead before approval.
Customers with 3 or more refunds in the last 90 days are sent to human review to check for abuse.
An order can be refunded only once. Requests for an order that was already refunded are rejected.
When the customer's claim conflicts with order or carrier records, the case goes to human review.

proposed_decision.rationale: E1 confirms ORD-1066 is a Digital Photo Editing Software Licence delivered on 2026-10-18, order_total $39.00, final_sale false. The customer's reason is changed_mind, not that the product does not work. Per R6 in E3, digital products are non-refundable once delivered unless defective/not working, so this changed_mind request is rejected. E2 shows no prior refunds, and the total is under $200, so R7/R8 do not apply.

critique.reason: All factual claims are supported by E1 (ORD-1066: Digital, delivered 2026-10-18, total $39.00, final_sale false), E2 (no prior refunds), and E3 (R6: delivered digital products are non-refundable unless defective/not working). The Python checks agree (category Digital, delivered true, order_total 39.0, already_refunded false), and category-specific R6 correctly governs over the general changed_mind rule R1.

customer_reply: We understand you no longer need the photo editing licence from order ORD-1066. Unfortunately, once a digital licence has been delivered, our policy does not allow refunds for a change of mind.
limitations: Could not verify actual product functionality beyond the customer's statement; no defect was reported.
